description: This file contains functions and constants for rendering a static scene on a canvas in the Excalidraw application, including grid rendering, element rendering, clipping, and throttled rendering.

methods.name: strokeGrid
methods.description: Draws a grid on the canvas with specified grid size, step, and zoom.

methods.name: frameClip
methods.description: Applies a clipping mask to the canvas based on a frame element.

methods.name: renderLinkIcon
methods.description: Renders a link icon on an element if it has a link.

methods.name: _renderStaticScene
methods.description: Main function to render the static scene on a canvas, including grid, elements, embeddables, and flowchart nodes.
